posts.title: What Nucleus Actually Does: An Engineer’s Guide to Whole Genome Sequencing
posts.description: What Nucleus actually is, from its CTO: a cheek-swab whole genome test (30x short-read) that reports your risk for 2,000+ diseases and doubles as a carrier screen, plus couple and IVF embryo results. How the pipeline works, how variants get reported, what to look for in any genetic test, and how the data is protected (doctor-ordered, CLIA/CAP lab, HIPAA, SOC 2 Type II).

posts.title: Expedia and SIXT: My Surprise Cancellation Fee
